description: This file contains default-setting functions for Kubernetes extensions v1beta1 API objects such as DaemonSet, Deployment, ReplicaSet, NetworkPolicy, and HTTPIngressPath.

methods.name: SetDefaults_DaemonSet
methods.description: Sets default values for a DaemonSet object, including labels, update strategy, and revision history limit.

methods.name: SetDefaults_Deployment
methods.description: Sets default values for a Deployment object, including labels, replicas, strategy, progress deadline, and revision history limit.

methods.name: SetDefaults_ReplicaSet
methods.description: Sets default labels and replicas for a ReplicaSet object.

methods.name: SetDefaults_NetworkPolicy
methods.description: Sets default protocol to TCP and policy types for a NetworkPolicy object.

methods.name: SetDefaults_HTTPIngressPath
methods.description: Sets default PathType for an HTTPIngressPath object.
